title: Exit codes explained
description:
Turn process exit codes into something a person can read.

```
0          -> success
1          -> failed (the program's own error code)
3221225477 -> 0xC0000005 STATUS_ACCESS_VIOLATION (crashed)
3221225725 -> 0xC00000FD STATUS_STACK_OVERFLOW (crashed)
259        -> STILL_ACTIVE: do not use 259 as a real exit code
```
hints: `std::printf("0x%08X", code)` prints the hex form with leading zeros.
requirements: Print each code in decimal and hex.
Codes with the top two bits set (0xC0000000) are NTSTATUS errors: name a few common ones.
Explain in a comment why `GetExitCodeProcess` returning 259 is ambiguous.
stretch: Add the Linux view: a process killed by a signal shows as 128 + the signal number in a shell.
